_comment: r11 (2026-09-25): generated images are no longer sent to the user automatically. The Gemini generate_image description (the variant every frozen capture carries) swaps its auto-send sentence for the explicit-send sentence. Exact one-sentence swap inside the tool description; inventories are fail-closed. Lifecycle names are CANDIDATE captures: the pinned SOURCE's loop-exhausted-1 also carries generate_image, but the candidate answers loop-exhausted with one request since r4 (active_compaction_lifecycle_migration.py).
sentence_before: The generated image will be sent to the user in the chat.
sentence_after: The image is saved and shown to you; it is not sent to the user automatically — use send_document_to_chat to share it.
